newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says has no plan to act on troubled bank - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan says has no plan to act on troubled bank - MOF.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry has no plans to take any action against financially troubled Musashino Shinkin Bank for now, Finance Minister Wataru Kubo told a news conference on Tuesday.

Musashino, a credit association which takes deposits and lends money mainly to members, said on Monday it faced financial problems with unrecoverable loans totalling 24.2 billion yen and had given up efforts to restructure on its own.
Referring to the bank's problems, Kubo said: "The Finance Ministry has not reached any conclusions on whether to take action against Musashino."
Kubo said he would like to monitor how the "shinkin" industry provides support to Musashino.
Zenshinren Bank, a central organisation of Japanese shinkin banks, said in a statement issued at midnight on Monday that it would bail out Tokyo-based Musashino.
